name: agent-bus
description: Message bus between Claude Code sessions, on one machine or across machines through a hub: an MCP channel that wakes the peer session, bus tools, hooks and a protocol skill

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: This account's name on the bus: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, _ or -. Must differ between accounts.

bus_dir.title: Bus directory
bus_dir.description: Directory shared by every account on this machine; holds the event log and session registry.

rate_limit.title: Loop guard: messages per window
rate_limit.description: Most messages two agents may exchange within the window below; more looks like a loop and is refused.

rate_window_seconds.title: Loop guard: window in seconds
rate_window_seconds.description: Length of the sliding window for the message limit above.

hub_url.title: Hub address
hub_url.description: https:// address of an agent-bus hub, for agents on other machines. Empty keeps the bus local. The token goes in a file, see docs/hub.md.
